summary: A North Pole man was arrested Nov. 18 on two felony counts of sexual abuse of a minor and arraigned the same day. A Fairbanks jury convicted a man of six sexual offenses, three of them against a child. The Fairbanks court opened eight criminal files on Nov. 17 and Nov. 18, and troopers reported a vehicle theft in North Pole. The court filing counts below are the weekly report's own counts for its window of Nov. 11 to Nov. 17; six of the filings listed here were made on Nov. 18, after that window closed, and do not appear in it.

entries.title: Sexual abuse of a minor charges: Donald Geuea
body: Donald Geuea, 63, of North Pole is charged with two counts of sexual abuse of a minor in the second degree - sexual contact with a child under 13 - each a Class B felony, punishable by up to 10 years. Both counts are recorded on the court file as domestic violence related.

Troopers say that following an investigation he was arrested on Nov. 18 on both counts, for offenses committed several years ago, and was remanded to the Fairbanks Correctional Center. The court file records the offense location as North Pole and the date of offense as June 1, 2023 on both counts.
Alaska State Troopers case AK26111367. Case 4FA-26-02308CR; he was arraigned Nov. 18 and the next court date is Nov. 25. He is charged, not convicted.

entries.title: Convicted of sexual assault and sexual abuse of a minor: David Garcia
body: A Fairbanks jury found David Garcia, 47, guilty on Nov. 18 of two counts of sexual assault in the second degree, three counts of sexual abuse of a minor in the first degree and one count of sexual abuse of a minor in the second degree.

The Department of Law says one victim reported a sexual assault by Garcia on Sept. 15, 2024, the day it happened, and that the ensuing Alaska State Troopers investigation uncovered evidence leading to additional charges for sexual abuse of that victim as a child in 2014 and 2016. The department says further evidence led to a charge concerning a second child victim from about 2017.

The jury found two aggravating factors, which the department says open the sentence to 99 years. Garcia was remanded into the custody of the Department of Corrections and is held without bail pending sentencing, set for March 22, 2027. The department says he faces a composite sentence of 32 1/2 to 495 years.

entries.title: Vehicle theft: 1990 Dodge Ramcharger taken from a North Pole property
body: A blue 1990 Dodge Ramcharger valued at about $5,000 was reported stolen from a residence in North Pole. Troopers record the report as vehicle theft in the first degree and theft in the second degree.
Troopers say they responded at about 10:26 a.m. on Nov. 18 and that the investigation is continuing. Nobody has been arrested or named as a suspect.
Alaska State Troopers case AK26113708.

entries.title: Criminal trespass arrest: Ahdalah Panikak Williamson
body: Ahdalah Panikak Williamson, 42, was arrested on a charge of criminal trespass in the second degree - entering or remaining unlawfully on premises - a Class B misdemeanor.
Fairbanks Police say the arrest was made at the 500 block of Twelfth Avenue in Fairbanks on Nov. 18 at 7:24 a.m. Police case 26003501.
A court file was opened the same day on a complaint. Case 4FA-26-02304CR; no court date is set. She is charged, not convicted.

entries.title: Theft charge: Jesse Mae May
body: Jesse Mae May is charged with theft in the fourth degree - taking property worth less than $250 - a Class B misdemeanor.
The offense is dated Sept. 16 at Fairbanks. The case was opened Nov. 17 and a summons was requested.
Case 4FA-26-02305CR. She is charged, not convicted.

entries.title: Driving with a revoked license: Daniel Jay Wright
body: Daniel Jay Wright is charged with driving with a license canceled, revoked or suspended following a previous conviction - driving after a conviction had already cost him his license - a Class A misdemeanor.
The offense is dated Nov. 14 at Fairbanks. The case was opened Nov. 17 on a citation.
Case 4FA-26-02310CR; next court date Dec. 22. He is charged, not convicted.

entries.title: Driving with a revoked license: Breana Franks
body: Breana Franks is charged with driving with a license canceled, revoked or suspended for a criminal offense - driving after a criminal conviction had cost her her license - a Class A misdemeanor.
The offense is dated Nov. 13 at Fairbanks. The case was opened Nov. 18 on a citation.
Case 4FA-26-02311CR; next court date Dec. 1. She is charged, not convicted.

entries.title: Instruction permit violation: Brandon James Huber
body: Brandon James Huber is charged with driving in violation of an instruction permit, recorded on the court file as a misdemeanor that is not classified.
The offense is dated Nov. 13 at Fairbanks. The case was opened Nov. 18 on a trooper charging document.
Case 4FA-26-02309CR; next court date Dec. 4. He is charged, not convicted.

entries.title: Assault reported on Eureka Avenue
body: Fairbanks Police recorded a report of assault at the 400 block of Eureka Avenue late on Nov. 16, with the offense window opening at 11:35 p.m. The report is logged as simple assault or other.
Nobody has been arrested or named. Fairbanks Police case 26003491, reported at 11:36 p.m.

entries.title: Trespass and assault arrest at a Fairbanks hotel
body: A man was arrested early Nov. 18 on allegations of criminal trespass and assault in the fourth degree, the charge for recklessly injuring someone. Troopers have not released his name.

Troopers say they were called to Pike's Waterfront Lodge in Fairbanks at about 12:09 a.m. after hotel staff received several complaints of a man shouting in one of the rooms. They say they determined he had been barred from the property since June 30, 2015, and that he had assaulted security staff before troopers arrived. He was taken to the Fairbanks Correctional Center.
Alaska State Troopers case AK26113591.

entries.title: DUI arrest: driver stopped for having no lights on in the snow
body: A driver was arrested on a charge of driving under the influence early Nov. 17 and troopers say charges are being forwarded to the District Attorney's Office. The driver has not been named.

Troopers say they saw a vehicle being driven at night during snowfall with no headlights or taillights illuminated near the Mitchell Expressway and South University Avenue at about 4:37 a.m. and stopped it. They say the driver had a medical emergency during breath testing at the trooper post and was taken by Fire-Rescue to Fairbanks Memorial Hospital, that a blood warrant was obtained after consulting prosecutors, and that the driver was then released to medical care.
Alaska State Troopers case AK26113233.

entries.title: Felony DUI charge: George M Goldy Sr
body: George M Goldy Sr is charged with felony driving under the influence with two or more prior convictions - drunk driving by someone already convicted twice - a Class C felony, punishable by up to five years. He is also charged with driving with a license revoked for a criminal offense, a Class A misdemeanor, and with reckless driving.
The charges are dated Nov. 13 at North Pole.
Case 4FA-26-02286CR; arraignment Nov. 20. He is charged, not convicted.
